scope: Read-only review of completed Java holdout and bundle review JSON, final analysis, prepared renderer source, rendered README, methodology and report status/evidence JSON. This receipt is the only file written by this reviewer.

bundle_screen.interpretation: Separate one-cohort external-validity screen; no significance or universal-performance claim.

interpretation_review.finding: Neither selected candidate demonstrates a reliable speed gain under the prespecified adjusted criterion. This does not prove zero effect, equivalence, or reliable regression.
interpretation_review.memory: VmHWM is approximate and includes warmup/JIT/measurement. Both HWM log-t95 intervals include one; no memory significance claim is supported by the selected descriptive endpoints. Allocation, current RSS and cgroup peak have distinct measurement windows.
interpretation_review.review_amendment: The exact v1/v2 source diff changes only the disclosed warmup VmHWM admission policy and anomaly reporting. Warmup-only dips require a later strictly higher retained sample; measured VmHWM and cgroup peak decreases remain fatal. The report identifies the amendment as post hoc, preserves the original failure, and makes no numerical accuracy-bound or proved-root-cause claim.
interpretation_review.inference_limits: Three independent cohorts give a limited variance estimate; log-t requires approximately normal independent log effects, and the three-cohort bootstrap is discrete. Persistent-JVM requests are not separate inferential units.
interpretation_review.scope_limits: No new Java/Go ratio, universal error-path equivalence, full upstream suite result, or timing benefit inferred from diagnostic activation.

minor_findings_resolved: The renderer now includes mean allocated bytes in the all-metrics tables.
